payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for different discourse relations, indicating which types the model performs best and worst on.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting implicit discourse relations with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing Comparison and Temporal relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
The model is not suitable for binary classification, indicating limitations in certain discourse relation types.
Explicit discourse relations achieve reasonable performance (F1 score > 90%), while implicit relations are more challenging to identify.
